styleLock.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real cool-toned new-Chinese tea room with a pale limestone wall #EDEFEA over a poured micro-cement floor #C9CCC7, one vertical timber-slat screen (格栅 partition) standing flat against the far wall as the shadow-casting element and a woven seagrass mat laid under the seating zone; a seamless cool moonstone studio sweep #EDEFEA blending into a pale micro-cement floor band #C9CCC7 for packshots, anatomy and spec screens; and one flat deep slate-green field #37423F carrying a single hairline celadon #7E9C93 rule for process and closing layouts. Images run full-bleed with no border at all: no corner brackets, no seal marks, no rounded cards; one clean copy zone per screen, never busy decor; the slat screen is scenery only and is never carried, tilted or leaned on
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool daylight grade: a 5000-5200K key entering high from an off-frame window at camera RIGHT at roughly a 45-degree elevation, so the slat screen throws parallel linear shadow bars across the floor and the near edge of the tabletop, plus a broad neutral sky bounce on the camera-left shadow side keeping the under-top shelf wings readable; one soft grounded contact shadow directly under each leg frame, a satin sheen running only along the moulded top rim and the glazed teaware, no warm lamp cast anywhere; this is deliberately NOT a warm 3000-3200K lace-raked window key and NOT a flat neutral 4200K downlight wash
styleLock.surfaceSystem: the tabletop renders as real solid timber exactly as supplied at a tawny amber-brown #96602F with visible grain running along the board length and a satin rather than mirror finish; the under-top cabinet front, the vertical slats and the shelf wings read darker at espresso #46281A with near-black #2A1A12 falloff in the slat gaps; the recessed tray well is a level sunken rectangle with a crisp inner edge, never a loose metal insert; any accompanying pad stays a matte burnt-orange woven surface #D2701E with a thin dark piping edge, never gloss vinyl; pale micro-cement floor #C9CCC7 with a faint trowel texture, a natural woven seagrass mat #B7AE99, celadon-glazed teaware #9FB6AE and one speckled stoneware vase — no marble, no glossy laminate, no plastic sheen
styleLock.typography: one modern light geometric sans family only, Chinese display set at 100-250 weight with wide tracking around 0.35em in #23302C on pale fields and #EDEFEA on slate fields, never a high-contrast Ming serif and never brush calligraphy; numerals and small labels share the same light sans at a hairline weight; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 26-40pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-13pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters; no seal, no stamp, no flourish over the first glyph
styleLock.iconSystem: 1px celadon #7E9C93 monoline pictograms inside thin hairline circles for the three-point feature row, plus small right-angle number chips drawn as 1px celadon outlines on #EDEFEA with a light-sans numeral, plus one full-width hairline rule as the only divider; no solid filled discs, no arrow-flag tags, no corner brackets, no seal circles, no gradient badges, no filled pill labels
styleLock.presentationRules: the tea table keeps one proportional scale and one identity in every frame: the same rectangular top with its slightly raised moulded rim, the same single recessed rectangular tray well in the top and where it sits, the same solid cabinet block hung under the top with its run of narrow vertical slats, the same open slatted shelf wings at each end, the same four straight square-section legs joined by the low floor-level frame, the same grain direction and the same tawny-and-espresso two-tone reading; accompanying stools or chairs appear only if they exist in the reference and then keep their exact count and slatted leg form; the table always stands on the floor with real contact shadows under every leg and never floats; interior verticals, wall corners, the slat screen and the mat edge stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (woven mat, teapot and cups, side stool, floor lamp base) always anchors human scale; the slight 3/4 camera-right key of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one room
noDrift: no warm 3000-3200K interior grade, no lace-curtain shadow rakes, no amber lamp cast and no vermilion anywhere in this set
no mixed fonts: never replace the light geometric sans with a Ming serif, a brush script or a heavy bold grotesque
no corner brackets, no seal circles, no arrow-flag tags, no solid icon discs, no rounded cards
no recoloured, re-toned or plastic-laminate tabletop; grain must run along the board length as supplied

no restyled product: the recessed tray well, the under-top slatted cabinet, the open shelf wings, the square legs and the low floor frame stay exactly as supplied; no added drawer fronts, doors, casters, metal legs or carved panels
no random backgrounds and no inconsistent lighting direction; all shadow bars must come from the same high camera-right window source
no people's faces: any figure must be anonymous and cropped above the shoulders with hands still and unbranded clothing, and never a child climbing, sitting on or hanging from the table or a stool

provenance.notes: 8 张详情页切片压缩为 10 镜，漏斗排序：月白格栅光茶室首屏 → 月白影棚单品主图 → 外置茶盘漏水与嵌盘一体对比 → 一桌三用摆位对比 → 待客茶席实景 → 嵌茶盘俯拍微距 → 桌下栅格柜体与开放层架侧拍 → 桌面与配凳变体排布 → 三处看点与通用参数表 → 青瓷光茶室收口。品类判定（看图，不看文件夹名）：『新中式家居』是笼统合集名，实拍反复出现的唯一主角是第 1、2、5、6、7 片里那张长方形实木茶桌——桌面有一圈微凸边线、靠远端开一处下沉长方形嵌盘位（内放青瓷茶器）、桌面下方吊一组竖栅条柜体、两端各一段开放式竖栅层架、四条直方腿并有一圈落地低框；故 hero 物体是茶桌而非官帽椅、博古架或背景墙，取 L1 家具家纺、L2 客厅家具（茶桌配主人与客座落在客厅／茶室待客区，taxonomy 无茶室项，客厅家具为最可辩护落点）、leaf 新中式茶桌茶台（嵌茶盘＋桌下栅格柜体＋开放层架＋矮凳）。已剥离并判定为他款或占位：第 2 片上方的弧形搭脑官帽椅与第 6、7 片出现的竖条背餐椅、第 3 片整幅的圆形餐桌与高背餐椅、第 6 片上方的圆桌纹理特写均属卖家模板里其他在售 SKU 与跨品残留图，不并入本品；第 2、3 片『品牌／品名／工艺／材质』四行数值区全为空米色块，第 4 片三枚深红方块与第 7 片两枚深褐方块均为未填色占位块，第 8 片仅为两枚『新中式古典』红块与会员二维码角标，全篇无任何可读参数，因此不改判、也不生成任何参数事实。源图全部中文营销字（新中式／红木制作 匠心品质／传承经典／产品简介／匠心制作 传承工艺／精选红木材质／传承手工／甄选红木 手工雕刻图案／生气工艺 纹理自然 现代中式禅意中国风实木家具／中国元素 营造清新脱俗的雅致／手工雕刻／传统古法工艺／造型优美 色泽自然／生漆工艺／细节展示／纹理清晰自然 工艺精湛／空间搭配展示／精湛工艺／新中式古典／加入会员 全店免费）一律剥离为 {selling_point_*}／{callout_*} 占位，末页『加入会员 全店免费』角标与二维码、店铺与公司自称一律不入图；特别地，红木树种、生漆漆面、手工雕刻与榫卯工序等断言全部转为占位并在 noDrift 与每条 Negative 中禁写，参数表四行只保留通用行名、数值全为占位。与库内已有套图差异化：家具家纺 客厅家具现由 jiajujiafang-xinzhongshi-shimu-shafa 占据（暖调 3000-3200K 纱帘斜射、墨灰 #4A4A50 背景墙加宣纸米白 #F5F2EC、朱砂 #9E2B25 印章、高对比明朝衬线、实心灰圆盘与朱砂箭头旗与中式角花细框、深色抛光石地 #2E2C2B），本模版整套反向：冷调 5000-5200K 高侧窗从画面右侧入射、由木格栅投出平行直条阴影，色板换成月白石 #EDEFEA 加松烟青墨 #37423F 加青瓷釉 #7E9C93（全篇无朱砂、无米黄），地面为浅微水泥 #C9CCC7 与剑麻地毯 #B7AE99，字体为宽字距细黑体、无衬线无印章，图标为 1px 青瓷细线圆盘与直角描边编号芯片（正是被前者禁用的语言），卖点主线从『裸露实木扶手与禅意客厅认领』换成『桌面一体嵌盘与桌下栅格收纳的功能性茶室』，且首屏与收屏改以站视平线机位成对呼应；也与 jiajujiafang-beiou-buyi-shafa 的米白雾灰蓝加编号芯片、jiajujiafang-huilan-buyi-zhuanjiao-shafa 的板岩灰蓝加粗黑无衬线不同，本套以青瓷细线与格栅光影为唯一识别。源图无人物出镜；本套仅第 5 镜允许一名肩部以上裁切、无脸、手不入画的匿名人物，其余镜全部禁人物，并明令禁止孩童攀爬桌椅、禁止搬抬或倚靠格栅屏风。所有垂直线（墙角、格栅竖条、屏边、地毯边）按校正竖直处理，并以茶器、剑麻地毯、条凳与花器作为真实尺度锚；桌面嵌盘位置、桌下竖栅柜体、两端开放层架、方腿与落地低框、木纹走向、茶棕与深咖双色关系在全部 10 镜中锁死一致。
